3: The reason is that they wanted: To build the wall - as it was the will of both of them - that is when the Sages obligated both of them to build [it]. And later, it challenges, "When they wanted? What [does it matter], let them retract it?" However if the two of them did not want it - such that one said, "It is enough to divide it with a bordermark of low wooden pegs planted into the ground" - we do not force him. And the other one may not [force the other and] say to him, "I do not want you to see my business."
